name: Jane Doe
about: Two or three sentences on what you do and what you are good at. Keep it concrete — what you have actually shipped or changed beats adjectives. This paragraph sets the width of the sidebar column, so a long one makes the whole CV taller.
skills: Second skill, which can wrap onto more than one line
interests: A short line about what you do outside work.

jobs.title: Job Title
jobs.intro: One or two sentences on the situation you walked into and what you were there to do. Optional — drop the paragraph if the bullets speak for themselves.

groups.label: Group label
bullets: What you did and what came of it. Numbers land harder than verbs.
A second bullet, with **an emphasised result** in the middle of it.

bullets: Group labels are optional — a job can be a flat list of bullets.
Older roles usually need fewer bullets than recent ones.
Two or three lines is plenty once a job is more than five years old.
